spirent_vpls_setup.description: Spirent plays two roles: (1) VPLS peer for PW data plane via vpls-stream with MPLS labels, (2) EVPN peer for RT-2 injection. MAC moves between remote-EVPN and PW are triggered by combining RT-2 inject/withdraw with vpls-stream start/stop.

scenarios.name: Non-sticky: remote EVPN -> PW; no RT change; not counted
scenarios.spirent_method: 1) Inject EVPN RT-2 via Spirent BGP (mac installed as remote B>). 2) Withdraw RT-2 (protocol-stop EVPN device). 3) Send same MAC via vpls-stream (PW learns it as v>). Verify: no suppression, MAC now on PW. NOTE: DNOS SI suppresses PW data-plane learning while EVPN entry exists -- must withdraw RT-2 BEFORE PW traffic.

show_commands: show evpn mac-table instance {pw_test_evpn_name} mac {test_mac} | no-more
show evpn mac-table instance {pw_test_evpn_name} mac {test_mac} | no-more

scenarios.name: PW -> EVPN; accept; static entry
scenarios.spirent_method: 1) Send MAC via vpls-stream (PW learns it as v>). 2) Stop PW stream. 3) Inject same MAC via EVPN RT-2. Verify: MAC stays v> on PW -- PW retains priority over non-sticky EVPN RT-2. NOTE: The EVPN RT-2 is accepted but does NOT override the active PW-learned MAC.

show_commands: show evpn mac-table instance {pw_test_evpn_name} mac {test_mac} | no-more

scenarios.name: Sticky EVPN RT-2 -> PW; IGNORE move (blackholing risk)
scenarios.spirent_method: 1) Inject sticky EVPN RT-2 via Spirent BGP. 2) Send same MAC via vpls-stream on PW. 3) Verify: move ignored, sticky EVPN kept.

scenarios.name: PW -> Sticky EVPN; accept; datapath static sticky
scenarios.spirent_method: 1) Send MAC via vpls-stream on PW. 2) Inject sticky EVPN RT-2 with same MAC. 3) Verify: sticky EVPN wins.

pw_test_evpn_name.description: Non-SI EVPN instance for PW testing

dnos_behavioral_discoveries.evpn_suppresses_pw_learning: When a MAC has a BGP-learned entry (B>), PW data-plane traffic with the same MAC does NOT create a v> entry. Must withdraw RT-2 BEFORE sending PW traffic.
dnos_behavioral_discoveries.pw_retains_priority_over_evpn_rt2: When a MAC is PW-learned (v>) and an EVPN RT-2 arrives for the same MAC, the PW entry is NOT overridden. v> remains selected.
dnos_behavioral_discoveries.sticky_evpn_always_wins_over_pw: Both directions: sticky EVPN ignores incoming PW moves (SC03) and overrides existing PW entries (SC04).
dnos_behavioral_discoveries.mac_table_format: 6 pipe-delimited columns: Flags|MAC|ESI|Nexthop|Label/VNI|Resolution. ESI is often empty. Use positional indexing, never filter empty columns.
dnos_behavioral_discoveries.stc_device_stop_disrupts_port: protocol-stop on one STC device briefly disrupts the port, glitching active streams on the same port. Send fresh PW traffic AFTER withdrawal.
